events.explanation: Gobuster user agent probing for a /.env secrets file with no browser-style headers indicates automated content-discovery enumeration on the honeypot.
Rapid follow-up probe of /.git/config by the same Gobuster scanner continues the automated sweep for exposed source-control and configuration data.

sessionVerdict.summary: A single source using the Gobuster enumeration tool is systematically requesting sensitive files, first /.env and then /.git/config, within a one-second interval. Both requests returned status 200, suggesting the honeypot is mimicking successful exposure of configuration and source-control artifacts. The activity is classic automated content-discovery reconnaissance aimed at harvesting secrets, credentials, or source code for follow-on exploitation, with no sign of exploit payloads or credential attempts in this session.
